title: AI Product Ad Templates for Photos and Videos | AIVideosUGC
description: Find AI product ad templates for photos and short videos. Choose a style, add one product photo, and get a new asset for your store or social feed.
h1: Product Ad Templates: Pick a Layout, Add a Photo
lead: Pick a ready-made layout, add one photo of your item, and download a picture or a clip for your store, your feed, or a paid placement.
card: Ready-made layouts for product pictures and short clips. Add your photo and download the next file.

faq.q: What is a product ad template here?
faq.a: It is a ready-made layout for a product picture or a short clip. You add one photo of your item and download a new file. You are not filming a creator.

faq.q: How do I turn a template into my own file?
faq.a: Open a template, upload one product photo, and check the preview. Download when the item, the color, and the framing look right.

faq.q: Why start from a template instead of a shoot?
faq.a: A template already has a scene and a framing. You skip booking a model and a studio, and you still see the credit cost before the job starts. Add a price or licensed music in your own editor after download.
Online shops that already have one clear photo of the product and need a listing still, a feed image, or a short clip.
No. Pick a template and upload a photo. Add a price, a headline, or licensed music in your own editor after download. Captions are not added for you.

Use the chips on the scene wall. Skincare is under Beauty and Personal Care. Clothing, Apparel, Food and Beverage, Footwear, Jewelry and Accessories, Tech and Electronics, and Health and Fitness each have a chip, along with accessories, pets, sports, and apps. Home layouts, such as a tidy-room clip, are in the template gallery on this page.

faq.q: Can I upload my own photo?
faq.a: Yes. Every template starts from the photo you upload, so the item in the file is yours. A clear, full view of the product gives you a fairer check.

faq.q: Which channels do these files fit?
faq.a: Picture templates are square by default, which suits a lot of listing galleries. Clip templates can be 9:16, 1:1, 16:9, 4:3, or 3:4, at 6, 10, 15, or 30 seconds. You upload the file yourself.
Browsing this page is free. Making a file uses credits, and the cost is shown before you start. A failed job returns its credits. Plan prices are on the pricing page.

faq.q: Can I use the download in paid ads?
faq.a: Yes. Finished photos and clips can be used commercially and have no watermark. You are responsible for claims, prices, and music you add later.

faq.q: Why not build every ad from a blank page?
faq.a: A template gives you a scene that already fits a selling moment, so you spend your time on the product and the offer instead of inventing a setup.
